name: paywall
title: Paywall
description: Animated paywall screens people actually read. A membership card lit by a drifting aurora (drag it to tilt), plans that tint as you pick them, a dark glow layout with an annual toggle and sliding price, and a free-trial timeline that draws itself. Comes with a “You’re Pro” success screen with confetti and a cancel flow that asks why and offers a reason to stay. Respects Reduce Motion.
